_about: Eugen von Bohm-Bawerk (1851-1914), Austrian economist: Capital and Interest, a critical history of economical theory, translated with a preface and analysis by William Smart (London and New York: Macmillan, 1890); The Positive Theory of Capital, translated by William Smart (1891; this copy G. E. Stechert's New York reprint of 1928, whose OCR spells the translator 'SMAET', so no translator claim is recorded for it); Karl Marx and the Close of his System, translated by Alice M. Macdonald with a preface by James Bonar (London: T. Fisher Unwin, 1898). Raw IA OCR, clean 0.92-0.93. US public domain (all printed before 1931). No uids minted.

bohm-bawerk-smart-capital-interest-1890: Capital and Interest, tr. William Smart (Macmillan, 1890)
bohm-bawerk-smart-positive-theory-1928: The Positive Theory of Capital, tr. William Smart (1891; Stechert reprint, 1928)
bohm-bawerk-macdonald-karl-marx-1898: Karl Marx and the Close of his System, tr. Alice M. Macdonald (Fisher Unwin, 1898)
